frames.gloss: A 按惯例/按理应当做某事（外部规范，而非主观意愿的 should）
frames.pattern_notes:
be supposed to 是固定情态链，整体表示'被期待/按规定应该'，不能拆成 suppose 的被动来读。疑问式 What are you supposed to do...? 专门用于询问习俗规范。
三例中 J03041 为自然对话；另两例为习俗话题的问答句，结构真实。

examples.s: Daisy: I guess next time you should ask what you're supposed to wear.
A: What are people in Korea supposed to do when they meet for the first time?
What are you supposed to do when you meet someone for the ﬁ rst time?

frames.gloss: S 往往/倾向于做某事（规律性倾向）
frames.pattern_notes:
tend 与 to 固定连用，后接原形动词；tend to 整体表主体的习性或规律倾向，不是一次性行为，也不是外部概率判断。
与已有 likely to（外部看来可能）相对：tend to 指主体自身的惯常性。主语常为群体或抽象名词。

examples.s: Many studies have shown that shy, passive children tend to be socially by their classmates.
Like humans, language tends to carry biases, which can lead to discrimination.

frames.gloss: 直到 B 才发生 A（否定状态一直持续到 B 为止）
frames.pattern_notes:
主句否定词与 until 连用，整句含义是'到 B 时 A 才发生'；中文极易反向理解为'到 B 为止一直 A'，极性反转是该框架的核心误读点。
变体：[used to V] ... until [事件]（见 S01633），肯定式表状态持续到某转折点为止。

examples.s: Don't eat it until you get to the forest.
While his notebooks were collected and prized by the kings of Europe, none of them were published until the late 19th century.

frames.frame: [NP] be one of the + [最高级/类别词] + [复数名词]
frames.pattern_notes:
one of the 后强制出现：定冠词 the + 最高级（或类别词）+ 复数名词，三者绑定为整体，谓语与 one 一致取单数。
典型误读是漏看复数或把最高级读成一般修饰；整存整取可避免'one of the most famous place'类错误。S02828 为无最高级的基本式（one of the + 复数类别名词）。

examples.s: Today, the Serengeti is one of the top tourist attractions in the world.
JOHN SNOW DEFEATS “KING CHOLERA” Cholera used to be one of the most feared diseases in the world, until a British doctor, John Snow, showed how it could be overcome.
Stretching over 2,300 kilometres, the Great Barrier Reef is considered one of the natural wonders of the world.

frames.pattern_notes:
be located in/at 表静态方位，是高频整存组合；located 是状态化的过去分词，不表动作、无施事，勿追问'谁 locate 它'。
接大范围用 in，接具体点位用 at；与 be situated in / lie in 同义但 be located in 最常用。

examples.s: The famous bar street is located in the area of the city.
Earth University is located in Guacimo, Costa Rica.

frames.gloss: ……的是……（Wh-伪分裂句，强调 is/was 之后的内容）
frames.pattern_notes:
句首 what 引导主语从句（非疑问义），系动词 is/was 之后才是信息焦点。第二例 is 换 was 且焦点带 probably 等修饰。
核心误读：把 what 当疑问词逐词翻译，导致整句读反；正确读法是先收住 what-从句，等系动词后的焦点。

examples.s: What we can say, however, is that culture and cuisine go hand in hand, and if you do not experience one, you can never really know the other.
However, what might have made him such an outstanding and creative scientist was probably his strong interest in other things, such as music and drawing.

frames.gloss: 像 A 一样，B 也……（句首类比框架）
frames.pattern_notes:
句首 Like + 名词短语 + 逗号 + 主句：Like 的宾语 A 与主句主语 B 对位建立类比，而非修饰谓语动词。
这是'明喻 like 框架'（like+NP 作动词后比拟）的句首新变体：整体前置后读者须把 A 挂靠到主句主语，逐词读容易挂错或读慢。

examples.s: Like Earth, Mars has volcanoes, valleys, polar ice caps, seasons, and weather.
Like his operas, the scores for Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon, and Hero use Chinese musical instruments and styles in a Western classical music score.
Like humans, language tends to carry biases, which can lead to discrimination.

frames.gloss: 就好像……（口语中 like 引出完整小句，相当于 as if）
frames.pattern_notes:
已有'明喻 like 框架'为 like + 名词短语；本变体 like 后直接接完整限定小句，义同 as if，属口语/非正式语域，规范书面语用 as if。
误读点：学习者预期 like 后只能接名词，遇到 like they are embarrassed 会读慢或误当作举例。第二例为省略式 like he had (seen it)。

examples.s: They may also hide their faces in their hands like they are embarrassed or ashamed.
When he got absorbed in his world of music, he felt as if he could “see” the beauty of the world around him, like he had in his previous life.

frames.frame: [V] so as to [V] / in order to [V]
frames.pattern_notes:
so as to 是固定虚词链，不可拆读成 so + as；拆读会读慢且误解为比较结构。仅表目的，其逻辑主语与主句主语一致。
in order to 为同义正式变体（可居句首），so as to 一般居句中动词后。

examples.s: Despite the huge risks though, people will always continue to explore this final f so as to learn its secrets.
Oddly, many of these notes are written backwards: You have to hold them up to the mirror in order to read them.

candidates.note: 让步框架 Whether [A], [B] or [C], [主句]：仅 1 例，未达两句门槛；骨架和误读潜力都好，待更多证据。

example.s: Whether you like Indian food, Western food or Japanese food, you'll find it all in Singapore!

candidates.note: Some [V-ing], some [V-ing], and others [V-ing] 列举三分框架：仅 1 例。

example.s: Some were feeding their horses, some were practising archery, and others were chatting or taking photographs.

candidates.note: 一句三件套（各自单例）：it seems that / may well（很可能）/ 比较级+than+认知动词——'more A than anyone thought' 的副词比较级新变体 'a lot sooner than most people believe'。

example.s: Regardless, it seems that humans living on Mars may well happen a lot sooner than most people believe.

candidates.note: make it [adj/NP] (for sb) to [V]：it 为虚指、误读风险高，但结构上属'不定式外置'，按判据 1 疑应排除（同结构另见 S00810 made it against the law to handle koalas），拿不准。

example.s: Using prior knowledge will make it easier for you to predict what you will hear.

candidates.note: with + [NP] + [V-ed] 伴随复合结构：仅 1 例且原句带空格。

example.s: After the war, the was left in ruins, with all of its completely destroyed.

candidates.note: I wonder + wh-陈述语序：2 例（另见 S04033 I wonder how relevant chemistry is to these students），但更接近嵌入疑问语法规条，骨架查表优势弱。

example.s: I wonder what life was like here in the past.

candidates.note: 话语标记 How shall/should I put this/it?：典型停顿填充框架，仅 1 例。

example.s: I’ve nearly got it, er, … How can/shall/should I put this/it?

candidates.note: The best way to [V] is to [V]：定义/建议高频框架，仅 1 例。

example.s: Perhaps the best way to understand Western art is to look at the development of Western painting over the centuries.

candidates.note: But if [过去式虚拟], then where would [X] be?：反事实修辞问句，仅 1 例。

example.s: But if we knew everything about the future, then where would the mystery and excitement be?

candidates.note: be born with [N]：正文与对应理解题各 1 例（J01415/J01442 疑同构重复），不敢计为两例。

example.s: Everyone is born with the ability to learn.

candidates.note: be used to [V]（被用来做）：与 used to（过去习惯）高频混淆，本批仅 1 例。

example.s: Are signposts used to help the reader understand the purpose of each paragraph?

candidates.note: [NP] is where [小句]（表语 where 从句）：仅 1 例。

example.s: Buckingham Palace C is where the king or queen lives.
And instead of driving to school or work, you ride your bike or walk.

candidates.note: with the objective of [V-ing]：正式目的介词短语，仅 1 例。

example.s: There are also structures built with the objective of bringing wildlife into the city.
